brand.name: Gardim
brand.description: Artisan Ice Cream and Specialty Coffee Shop in Ranelagh, Buenos Aires
brand.location: C. 362 598-500, B1886DCJ Ranelagh, Provincia de Buenos Aires, Argentina

scales.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-light

spacing_and_layout.section_padding: py-24 md:py-32 px-6 md:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto

design_rules.hero_overlay: Do NOT use full flat black overlay. Use a very subtle gradient bg-gradient-to-t from-black/40 via-black/10 to-transparent, placed only where text needs contrast.
design_rules.buttons: Flat, pure geometric rectangles (rounded-none). Primary buttons in espresso (#1A110A) with ivory text. Hover state: slight lift, change bg to terracotta (#9E4733).
design_rules.marquee: Slow 'Editorial Ribbon' below the hero. Font: Cormorant Garamond, text-xl. Text: '✧ Heladería Artesanal ✧ Cafetería de Especialidad ✧ Ranelagh ✧'. Background: #EAE5DF, Text: #2A1E17.
design_rules.borders: Use 1px borders in #D6CEC4 (tertiary background) to divide sections and create grid-based bento layouts.
design_rules.motion: Use smooth, slow reveal animations for text. Image parallax on scroll. No bouncy/fast transitions.

sections_and_components.name: Navigation
sections_and_components.instructions: Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md). Logo text centered in Cormorant Garamond. Links left/right. Include CTA for 'Contacto' opening WhatsApp.

sections_and_components.name: Hero Section
sections_and_components.instructions: Large immersive image taking 80vh. H1 typography 'Gardim' overlaying the image. Subtitle: 'Heladería y Cafetería Artesanal'. Text must be high contrast.

sections_and_components.name: Editorial Marquee
sections_and_components.instructions: Organic flowing text strip conveying brand values. See design_rules.

sections_and_components.name: Signature Products
sections_and_components.instructions: Asymmetric bento grid highlighting 'Copa Gardim', 'Café Gardim', 'Don Pedro', 'Affogato'. Use hover zoom effects on images. No cards, just pure grid borders.

sections_and_components.name: Full Typographic Menu
sections_and_components.instructions: Left sidebar (sticky): Menu Categories. Right area: Typographic list of items. Categories include: Cafetería, Cafés especiales, Repostería, Desayunos y Meriendas, Panqueques salados, Panqueques dulces, Cafés fríos, Bebidas, Individuales, Copas heladas, Batidos, Tostados, Ensaladas de frutas, Hora del Té, Helados. Design like a high-end restaurant physical menu.

sections_and_components.name: About / Nuestra Historia
sections_and_components.instructions: Left: Large emotional typography explaining the artisan approach in Ranelagh. Right: Tall portrait image of the cafe facade.

sections_and_components.name: Instagram Gallery
sections_and_components.instructions: 6 to 9 images in an asymmetrical masonry or tight grid pattern. Include Instagram handle prominently overlaid or above the grid.

sections_and_components.name: Location & Footer
sections_and_components.instructions: Huge typography for the CTA 'Vení a conocernos' (text-7xl). Include embedded Google Map to C. 362 598-500, B1886DCJ Ranelagh. Footer links: WhatsApp, Instagram, Horarios. Contrast shift: Background #1A110A (Espresso), Text #F8F5F0 (Ivory).

hero.description: A scoop of artisan gelato on a table, elegant lighting. Use for the main hero.

signature_products.description: Cappuccino on a wooden table. Use for Café Gardim / Coffee highlight.
Person holding white ice cream cup. Use for Helados / Copa Gardim highlight.
White ceramic mug. Use for Specialty Coffee highlight.

about.description: Gelateria entrance with warm lighting. Use for the 'Nuestra Historia' section.

gallery.description: Person holding gelato cup in front of display.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid attributes
